outcome: Give hotel gm / hospitality revenue director a governed method to improve contribution margin per package using supplier contracts, bookings and cancellation patterns, with final decisions retained…
overview: Tour Operator Package Margin Monitoring addresses telemetry is noisy or missing, so operators spend time interpreting unrelated warnings in hospitality and tourism operations. The first proof of value uses supplier contracts, bookings and cancellation patterns. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is contribution margin per package, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: supplier contracts, bookings and cancellation patterns; define contribution margin per package and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Hotel GM / Hospitality Revenue Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including inject sensor failures, stale data and dependency loss into the pilot.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for contribution margin per package
